caption: soulcalibur's pocket proof - the soul engine at 60fps with kratos as the guest blade.
about: Soulcalibur: broken destiny (2009) compresses the soul engine onto psp without dropping the frame rate: the soulcalibur iv combat system, a trimmed roster plus god of war's kratos as the guest fighter, and the quick-match gauntlet mode built for handheld sessions. It remains the best weapons fighter the handheld ever carried.
No windows build exists, so the platform is psp - played through ppsspp, rom sourced from romsfun.

req.note: at target - the psp build runs through ppsspp within the haswell bar.
